args.body:
Summary of websites shared in #general:

• www.informations.com — Shares the latest job report, which brought a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, known for authentic Swiss cuisine such as cheese fondue, hearty rösti, and chocolate fondue for dessert. Warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia, panoramic city skyline views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire make it feel like a journey to the Swiss Alps.

Hi Dora! I visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, clean introduction — it clearly identifies it as your personal site and makes it easy to get in touch via email. A couple of suggestions to make it even more engaging: add a bit more about yourself (your interests, work, or projects) and maybe a few links or photos so visitors get a fuller sense of who you are. Overall, a friendly and straightforward welcome page — keep it up!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com). It's a great start — the personal touch of mentioning your favorite hobby (hiking) gives readers an immediate sense of your personality. To make the blog more compelling, consider adding some actual blog posts or entries, a short bio, and maybe a few photos from your hikes. Sharing your hiking experiences would really bring the site to life. Looking forward to seeing more of your content!
